title: Tallahasse
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office prepares for a trip with chaotic mornings, humorous conflicts, and character interactions. Dwight seeks a vice-presidency and discusses his ambitions, while Jim deals with a trashed room and reflects on his feelings about Pam. The episode also features a humorous misunderstanding about Dwight's poisoning and a scene where Nellie introduces herself and discusses her plans for a new Sabre store.
